packageRules.description: Majors land through scripts/renovate-agent.ts, which reads this label.

The package files under scripts/check-e2e-green.ts's e2e paths land through scripts/renovate-agent.ts and land.ts, which runs the e2e suite; scripts/renovate-agent.integration.test.ts holds this list to that predicate.
The package files under .claude/agent-hooks.jsonc's profile.review.risky land only with a human review verdict; scripts/renovate-agent.integration.test.ts holds this list to that profile.
